messages:
olivia: quick alert: customers hitting 5xx when fetching embeddings in eu-central-1 since ~09:17 UTC. looks like a cache-consistency regression after yesterday's cache-split config. opening incident thread. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1864922222
jamal: oncall here. confirmed ~0.9% of embedding read requests returning 502/504. enabled read-through fallback to primary embed-store for critical customers and temporarily routed high-priority traffic to eu-west-1.
priya: investigating root cause  early signal shows stale index pointers after shard split, causing some lookups to hit an empty shard and trigger timeouts. preparing a config rollback for the cache-routing layer.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollback of cache-routing v2.1.0 -> v2.0.7 in eu-central-1, batch 1/2, sha=9f3a12b. CI: https://ci.redwood/build/8135
jamal: after enabling fallback and batch1 rollback, error rate down from 0.9% -> 0.15%. queueing batch2 after validation. monitoring p95 and error traces.
ops-bot: monitor: detected increased downstream DB read traffic; added temporary rate limits for non-critical embedding reads to protect embed-store. Alert id=embed-db-3344.
support: notified 9 impacted customers with holding language: "We're mitigating an issue causing intermittent embedding lookup failures in eu-central-1. We've applied fallbacks and are rolling a fix. We'll follow up with ETA."
priya: batch2 rollback completed. verifying consistency sweep now (background job to reconcile pointers). will run reconciliation until error traces clear. expected 30-45m for sweep.
jamal: setting severity=SEV2 given customer impact to embeddings. will coordinate a short executive note once reconciliation completes. incident doc + timeline: https://go.redwood/incident/1864922222/summary
olivia: mitigation checklist: 1) enable read-through fallback (done), 2) route high-priority to eu-west-1 (done), 3) rollback cache-routing (done), 4) run pointer reconciliation (in progress), 5) customer outreach (done). keep thread updated.
